title: Hope Cruiser
description: A Maldives dive liveaboard with six cabins for up to 12 guests, a dedicated dive tender and an open sundeck. Itineraries commonly include Malé and Ari Atolls; confirm the selected route.
priceNote: Our 7-night offer is $1,850; we’ll confirm the rate basis, inclusions and availability for your dates.

details.title: Hope Cruiser
details.overview: A small-group dive liveaboard with a dedicated diving tender and routes around the central atolls.
details.route: Our itineraries commonly visit South Malé and South Ari dive sites. We’ll confirm the route and sites for your departure.
details.vessel: Six cabins for up to 12 guests, a separate dive tender, an open sundeck and indoor/aft dining areas.
includes: We’ll confirm meals, dives and other inclusions for your selected departure before you book.
activities: Guided diving, with up to three dives per day on many trip days
Night dives may be included, depending on the schedule
Marine encounters vary by route and can’t be guaranteed
details.transfers: We’ll arrange your pickup details and confirm the embarkation point, airport transfer and timing for your departure.
details.priceBasis: Our 7-night Hope Cruiser offer is $1,850. Cabin choice and required fees may affect your final total; contact us and we’ll confirm the rate basis, inclusions and availability for your dates.
importantNotes: The cruiser has six cabins for up to 12 guests. A minimum of six divers may apply; we’ll confirm group requirements for your departure.
Routes commonly include South Malé and South Ari, but itineraries and dive sites vary. We’ll confirm your route before booking.
We’ll provide the final price, required fees and included services with your quote.
